title: Shared Item-Level Error Limits the Aggregation of Small Language Models in Fermi Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems of language models are often motivated by an averaging argument: if the agents' errors are unbiased and independent, the error of an aggregate of N answers falls as 1/sqrt(N). Fermi estimation, whose continuous answers are aggregated on the logarithmic scale, permits a direct test. We decompose the log10 error of each answer into the mean error of its model on the item, common to all its draws on the item, and a residual, and estimate both from 2.51M answers given before any communication by 15 open-weight models (3B-72B) on realFP, with replication under a single prompt pair on realFP, Science Olympiad Fermi questions and a guesstimation set. Given the item, teammates' errors are uncorrelated and teams behave as independent draws, but the item-level component accounts for a median 0.906 of the error variance over items. Teams of thirty therefore reduce a single agent's error by a median 1.7% (at most 5.4%), whereas

translated_title: 共享的题目级误差限制了小语言模型在费米估算中的聚合
translated_abstract: 语言模型的多智能体系统通常基于一个平均化论证：如果各智能体的误差无偏且相互独立，那么N个答案聚合后的误差将按1/√N的速度下降。费米估算的连续答案在对数尺度上进行聚合，为直接检验这一论断提供了可能。我们将每个答案的log10误差分解为两部分：该模型在该题目上的平均误差（对该题目上的所有抽样而言是共同的）以及一个残差，并利用15个开放权重模型（3B-72B）在realFP上于任何通信之前给出的251万个答案对两者进行估计，同时在realFP、科学奥林匹克费米问题和一个粗略估算题集上通过单一提示对进行重复实验。在给定题目的情况下，队友之间的误差是不相关的，团队表现为独立抽样，但题目级成分占据了题目间误差方差的中位数0.906。因此，由三十个智能体组成的团队仅能将单个智能体的误差降低中位数1.7%（最多5.4%）……
tldr: 该研究发现小语言模型在费米估算中存在共享的题目级误差（占误差方差中位数0.906），导致多智能体聚合几乎无法降低误差，三十个智能体的团队仅能将误差降低中位数1.7%。
en_tdlr: Shared item-level error, accounting for a median 0.906 of error variance, severely limits the aggregation benefit of small language model teams in Fermi estimation, with thirty-agent teams reducing error by only a median 1.7%.
